```sql
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS rating_weighted_win_rate
FROM main."Match" m, main."Player_Attributes" pa
WHERE CAST(m.date AS DATE) = DATE '2013-12-01'
  AND CAST(pa.date AS DATE) = DATE '2013-12-01';
```
